steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; globalThis.__b6living = { before: JSON.stringify(rt.loaded.record.raw), project: () => JSON.stringify(rt.loaded.record.raw), state: () => rt.extras.living, sleep: (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)) }; const p = await rt.living.propose(); if (p?.status !== 'proposed' || !p.ops.length) throw new Error('director did not propose: ' + JSON.stringify(p)); globalThis.__b6living.proposal = p.id; if (globalThis.__b6living.project() !== globalThis.__b6living.before) throw new Error('proposal changed graph before boundary'); await rt.living.decide(p.id, 'accepted'); if (globalThis.__b6living.project() !== globalThis.__b6living.before) throw new Error('accept changed graph before boundary'); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ livingEnabled: true }); return { proposed: p.id, operations: p.ops.length };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const b = globalThis.__b6living; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !b.state().ops.length; i += 1) await b.sleep(100); if (!b.state().ops.length || b.project() === b.before) throw new Error('living-apply did not grow the graph'); if (!b.state().proposals.some((p) => p.id === b.proposal && p.status === 'applied')) throw new Error('proposal not applied'); b.applied = b.project(); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); b.appliedMessage = ctx.chat.length - 1; const reply = ctx.chat.at(-1); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'The bell stays silent.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); await b.sleep(2500); await ctx.reloadCurrentChat(); await b.sleep(2500); if (b.project() !== b.applied || !b.state().ops.length) throw new Error('reopen lost applied graph'); rt.setStagecraftSettings({ livingEnabled: false }); return { operations: b.state().ops.length, reopenEqual: true };
